name: Confluence
blurb: The longest-running science-fiction, fantasy and horror conference in southwestern Pennsylvania, run by nonprofit Parsec Inc., with writing workshops, music and an art show.
notes: Confluence is active and still running annually in person (not the batch note's 2020 'C'monfluence' virtual hiatus, which has ended) -- its most recent edition ran July 24-26, 2026 ('We hope to see you at Confluence on July 24-26, 2026!' on the registration page; 'Post Confluence JULY 27, 2026: Another Confluence has come and gone' on the homepage), just before our window starts; its hotel page points to a Sheraton near Pittsburgh (zip 15108, Coraopolis/airport area). The Registration page says explicitly 'Once we have a hotel contract, we'll open pre-registration' and only commits to an early-bird price ($55) 'through December 31, 2026' -- no venue contract and no 2027 dates have been announced yet, so editions is left empty rather than guessing a date from the usual July pattern.
